mapper.select:
SELECT cr.id, cr.reporter_id, cr.comment_id, cr.report_reason, cr.status, cr.report_time, cr.review_result, cr.review_reason, cr.reported_user_id, u.username as reporterName, c.content as comment_content, c.user_id as comment_user_id, c.status as commentDeleted, u2.username as comment_username, a.username as reviewerName FROM comment_report cr LEFT JOIN user u ON cr.reporter_id = u.id LEFT JOIN comment c ON cr.comment_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON c.user_id = u2.id LEFT JOIN user a ON cr.reviewer_id = a.id
AND cr.reporter_id = #{reporterId} AND cr.comment_id = #{commentId} AND cr.status = #{status} AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{reporterName}, '%') AND c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{commentContent}, '%')
ORDER BY cr.report_time

SELECT cr.id, cr.reporter_id, cr.comment_id, cr.report_reason, cr.status, cr.report_time, cr.reviewer_id, cr.review_time, cr.review_result, cr.review_reason, cr.reported_user_id, u.username as reporterName, c.content as comment_content, c.blog_id as blog_id, c.user_id as comment_user_id, u2.username as comment_username, a.username as reviewerName FROM comment_report cr LEFT JOIN user u ON cr.reporter_id = u.id LEFT JOIN comment c ON cr.comment_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON c.user_id = u2.id LEFT JOIN user a ON cr.reviewer_id = a.id WHERE cr.id = #{id}
